बॉलीवूड के गलियारों से आ रही है सबसे चटपटी खबर, जानिए Ramayana की ओपनिंग का पूरा गणित! 🎬✨

रणबीर कपूर और यश स्टारर फिल्म Ramayana की एडवांस बुकिंग ग्लोबल लेवल पर दशहरा के दिन यानी रिलीज से 15 दिन पहले शुरू हुई थी। 🎟️

डिस्ट्रीब्यूटर्स और एक्जिबिटर्स के बीच रेवेन्यू शेयरिंग को लेकर तनातनी के चलते भारत में बुकिंग्स अटक गई थीं और ज्यादातर स्क्रीन्स पर बुकिंग सिर्फ पांच दिन पहले खुली। ⚠️

रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, रिलीज से एक दिन पहले बुधवार सुबह तक भारत में फिल्म ने ओपनिंग वीकेंड के लिए 77 करोड़ रुपये की ग्रैस प्री-सेल कर ली है, जिसमें अकेले ओपनिंग डे के लिए करीब 33 करोड़ रुपये शामिल हैं। 💰

ओवरसीज एडवांस बुकिंग को मिलाकर ग्लोबल प्री-सेल 125 करोड़ रुपये पहुंच चुकी है, जिसमें से करीब 70 करोड़ रुपये ओपनिंग डे के लिए हैं। 📉

ट्रेड इंसाइडर्स का दावा है कि फिल्म का ग्लोबल कलेक्शन पहले दिन 160 करोड़ रुपये ग्रॉस तक जा सकता है, जबकि कुछ कंजर्वेटिव अनुमान इसे 150 करोड़ रुपये बता रहे हैं। 📊

सोनी द्वारा दुनिया भर में 70,000 स्क्रीन्स पर रिलीज की जा रही Ramayana भारत की इतिहास की सबसे बड़ी रिलीज होगी, लेकिन ट्रेड जानकारों का अनुमान है कि यह Pushpa 2, RRR और Baahubali 2 जैसी फिल्मों के ओपनिंग रिकॉर्ड से पीछे रह सकती है। 🚀

क्या आपको लगता है कि रणबीर और यश की यह जोड़ी बॉक्स ऑफिस पर सारे पुराने रिकॉर्ड तोड़ पाएगी? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Ramayana box office prediction: With  ₹160 crore projected start, Ranbir Kapoor-Yash film dwarfs Jawan and Animal, but no match for Dhurandhar 2, RRR
ctx.summary: Ramayana stars Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash. It is the biggest Indian film ever in terms of budget and release scale.
ctx.text:
It may be the biggest Indian film ever, getting the widest release in Indian cinema history, but alas, Ramayana is not on course to set the biggest opening for an Indian film. In fact, if the current trends hold, it may not even break into the top five biggest openings by Indian films. Despite this, Ramayana is on course for a massive start at the box office, just not as big as a film of this scale would have warranted.
Advance bookings for Ramayana began globally on Dussehra, 15 days before the film’s wide release. There was an early push, and overseas pre-sales took off immediately, but in India, ticket booking hit a roadblock. There was disagreement between the exhibitors and the film’s distributors over revenue sharing, which meant that most screens did not open up bookings till just five days ago. However, Ramayana gained momentum as release week approached. By Wednesday morning, with less than 24 hours to go for the release, Ramayana had grossed ₹ 77 crore in pre-sales in India for its opening weekend. The opening day alone accounted for around ₹ 33 crore of this. Overseas, the film has collected $5.6 million in advance bookings, including $1.5 million for the paid previews in North America. This takes the film’s global advance booking to ₹ 125 crore. But only about ₹ 70 crore of it is for the opening day (including paid previews)
Ramayana has collected ₹ 33 crore in gross pre-sales for its opening day in India, with a day to go before release. The film has a shot at crossing ₹ 40 crore by the end of the day. This could translate into an ₹ 80 crore net opening day for the film in India. Surprisingly, the Hindi version is looking to dominate the proceedings, contributing around ₹ 55-60 crore to the total net. Despite Yash ’s presence, the Kannada version does not look to open at record levels. Overseas, the North American paid previews have painted an encouraging picture for the Nitesh Tiwari film. According to trade insiders, the film could earn $1.6 million in paid previews and over $5 million on day 1. This would translate to a global start of ₹ 160 crore gross. Some conservative estimates put the figure closer to ₹ 150 crore, while some optimistic ones still hope the film will inch toward the ₹ 200-crore mark, even if that now looks increasingly difficult.
A post shared by Ramayana: Rise of a Legend (@ramayanamovie)
Ramayana is getting the widest release ever for an Indian film, with Sony distributing it in 70,000 screens worldwide. As a result, many trade insiders had expected the film to have a bigger opening overseas. But so far, that does not seem to be materialising. Ramayana will likely miss a ₹ 200-crore opening day and stay behind all-time record holders Pushpa 2 ( ₹ 274 crore), RRR ( ₹ 223 crore), and Baahubali 2 ( ₹ 214 crore). Makers of Ramayana may be disappointed that it also looks set to miss Dhurandhar 2’s Bollywood record of ₹ 205 crore, set earlier this year. The film also looks set to miss the top 5, which is rounded off by Kalki 2898 AD ( ₹ 176 crore). It may, however, pip KGF Chapter 2 ( ₹ 159 crore).
Ramayana will still easily soar past the opening day of the previous Ramayana adaptation, Adipurush. The Prabhas-starrer opened at ₹ 127 crore in 2024. It will also beat the opening-day collections of other Bollywood blockbusters like Shah Rukh Khan’s Jawan ( ₹ 129 crore) and Ranbir Kapoor’s Animal ( ₹ 116 crore).
Produced by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios in collaboration with DNEG and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations, Ramayana is planned as a two-part film. The film stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. The first part is scheduled for worldwide release on November 5, 2026, while the second part is set for Diwali 2028.
